comparison.objective: Erect and latch a folded crate for filling; unlike selective screen separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Unfold articulated walls and engage four corner catches, not tilt/agitate a loose-body load.
comparison.success_condition: All four walls must be upright, all corners latched, crate retained, and hands released for the dwell; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Tests articulated assembly and multi-corner latching.
